final_defects_note: Both remaining defects are pre-existing and outside the low change budget: (1) Badge text baseline ~1px below the row baseline in the Status column (shared Badge component used on 6 screens); (2) the whole app has no responsive behaviour at 390px (fixed 240px rail), identical before and after this change.

bad_guidance.why: Tells how to build a list+detail pane; the task is a numeric defect inside one tab of an already-built detail screen. Nothing actionable.
Correct component identification, but roving tabindex / URL state / lazy panels are unrelated to the reported defect.
One clause touches the screen (status colour never alone, legible numerics); the rest (patient banner, autosave, destructive confirmation) is off-task and outside a low budget.

guidance_ignored.why: the master-detail shell already exists and the task is not about it
tab behaviour is not the defect; changing it would risk the existing tab state
banner / autosave / confirmation clauses are outside the billing tab and the low change budget

process_records_reason: SKILL.md §2 (inspect first), §6 (build in the project's component model, do not break routes/state/semantics) and §7 (render, look, fix, re-render) produced both the reuse decision and the render loop that caught the cross-screen mismatch. impl-reuse-before-new and verify-render-and-inspect were demanded as recommended concepts and dropped at bundle selection; that cost nothing here.

misses.what: 'billing tab shows amounts' yielded components=['tabs'] only; no table / data-display component, so the table records had no structural path into the candidate set

'amounts that do not line up' does not retrieve data-tables-numeric ('Right-align numbers with tabular lining figures ... totals visually distinct', keywords 'numeric alignment', 'align numbers', 'totals') or table-column-disambiguation; both absent from the top 12 of search, while TV/mobile/ecommerce records outrank them
a11y.semantics, a11y.color_not_only and process.render_verify were never demanded although carriers exist in the base
data.kpi_comparison — the 'displayed figure must agree with its reference figure' idea that this task is actually about — was never demanded and has no carrier record
layout.spacing_scale and process.reuse_first had live candidates and were dropped; 3 of 4 bundle slots went to records that contributed nothing to the reported defect

knowledge_gaps: No record in data/rules.jsonl carries data.kpi_comparison, and none covers 'a summary figure (header badge, KPI) must reconcile with the rows it summarises' — the actual defect behind this sentence.
